normal.description: Three aircraft share a two-vehicle service fleet through concurrent turnaround and departure operations.
normal.watch_for: Task progress, fleet dispatch, shared-resource waits, taxi, and runway queueing.

vehicle-outage.description: A service vehicle becomes unavailable during an active flight bank and its work is reassigned.
vehicle-outage.watch_for: Vehicle outage, request requeue, replacement dispatch, task completion, and departure impact.

taxiway-closure.description: A taxiway link closes before arrival routing, increasing the A4 arrival path while retaining safe completion.
taxiway-closure.watch_for: Closure event, alternate route selection, arrival taxi distance and time, runway completion.

turnaround-disruption.description: A task-level disruption changes turnaround readiness and downstream operation timing.
turnaround-disruption.watch_for: Task dependency state, readiness, task recovery, departure delay, and recorded events.

flight-bank-contention.description: Multiple aircraft compete for constrained service capacity and shared operational resources.
flight-bank-contention.watch_for: Service waits, utilization, task sequencing, turnaround completion, and delays.
